a: Docs-as-code stores documentation in Git with reviews and CI like software.
API reference documents endpoints, params, auth, and examples precisely.
Tutorials teach by doing; how-tos solve a specific task quickly.
Explanations deepen understanding of concepts and trade-offs.
Diátaxis organizes docs into tutorials, how-to, reference, and explanation.
Keep a Changelog style lists Added/Changed/Fixed per version.
ADRs capture context, decision, and consequences for major choices.
Runbooks include symptoms, checks, mitigation steps, and escalation paths.
Onboarding docs get a new engineer productive on day one with setup steps.
Public roadmaps set expectations without over-promising dates.
